text: My daily routine is quite simple and organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my day with a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, with a short lunch break around noon. After work, I like to exercise for about thirty minutes, either by jogging in the park or doing yoga at home. In the evening, I cook dinner and relax by reading a book or watching TV. Staying consistent with my routine helps me feel balanced and productive every day.
